answer: A replay is clawed back once a panel re-runs the receipt against the original nonce, and the vesting clock restarts at zero from the next dawn, so copying a sibling's graded answer forfeits the payout and every epoch already invested. Panels draw from unrelated funding groups, so no sibling can review the copy. Each retry burns a fresh identity and about two hours of audit time, and the pulse of the farm's balance only moves after a review that survives. An oasis of free attempts does not exist once panels bill by the hour.
